full_text: L.A. Care Health Plan Medi-Cal Provider Directory. Full document, 21 Megabytes. Accurate as of March 1, 2026. This directory lists primary care physicians, specialists, clinics, pharmacies, and urgent care centers under the L.A. Care Medi-Cal network, covering Los Angeles County.
summary: The complete L.A. Care Medi-Cal Provider Directory for 2026, accurate as of March 1, 2026. This 21MB document is a reference directory listing network providers, clinic locations, and facility hours for Medi-Cal members.
